title: ANCHOR: A Port-Hamiltonian Model for Forecasting Team Dynamics in Human-in-the-Loop Systems
abstract: arXiv:2611.19124v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Cyber-physical-human systems close a loop around people by sensing human behavior, predict it and act on it. Human teams are a natural target, because collaboration breaks down in ways that a timely prompt could prevent. Collaborative mixed reality makes this loop practical, since each headset senses who speaks, where its wearer looks and who stands together, and it can deliver a light prompt. In this loop, the headsets are sensors, the prompts are actuators and the team is the plant. Closing the loop needs a plant model that is small enough to learn from few teams, safe to iterate and readable by a designer. We propose ANCHOR, which models a team as a ball in an energy bowl. The bottom of the bowl is where the team rests, and it is set by the team's recent behavior, its own history and other teams. Formally, ANCHOR is a switched port-Hamiltonian system with 52 parameters, and each part stands for a testable claim from team psychology.

translated_title: ANCHOR：一种用于预测人在回路系统中团队动态的端口哈密顿模型
translated_abstract: 信息-物理-人类系统通过感知人类行为、对其进行预测并采取行动，从而围绕人形成一个闭环。人类团队是天然的目标对象，因为协作的破裂往往可以通过及时的提示来预防。协作式混合现实使这一闭环变得切实可行，因为每个头显设备都能感知谁在说话、佩戴者在看哪里以及谁站在一起，并且能够发出轻量级提示。在这个闭环中，头显是传感器，提示是执行器，团队是被控对象。闭合这一环路需要一个足够小的被控对象模型，能够从少数团队中学习、可安全地迭代，并且设计师能够读懂。我们提出了 ANCHOR，它将团队建模为能量碗中的一个球。碗底是团队的稳定状态所在，它由团队的近期行为、自身历史以及其他团队共同决定。形式上，ANCHOR 是一个具有 52 个参数的切换端口哈密顿系统，其每个部分都对应团队心理学中一个可检验的论断。
tldr: 该论文提出 ANCHOR 模型，将团队建模为能量碗中的球（一个仅含52个参数的切换端口哈密顿系统），用于在人机闭环系统中预测团队动态，且模型的每个部分都对应团队心理学中可检验的论断。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes ANCHOR, a switched port-Hamiltonian system with only 52 parameters that models a team as a ball in an energy bowl to forecast team dynamics in human-in-the-loop systems, where each component corresponds to a testable claim from team psychology.
